name: edutrack
description: EduTrack — plataforma de cursos online (NestJS + React) feita para servir de sistema-alvo em estudos de automação de testes.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
